trello.name: Implement Queue Depth Alerts
trello.desc: Set up alerting for the payment worker queue depth. Trigger a warning at 1,000 jobs and a page at 5,000 jobs. Apply the same alerting thresholds across the entire worker fleet.

trello.name: Revise Retry Logic in Payment Worker
trello.desc: Modify the retry logic in the payment worker to use exponential backoff with jitter. Cap the number of retries and ensure failed jobs are placed in a dead-letter queue at the back of the main queue. Add tests simulating processor 503s.

trello.name: Adjust Database Connection Pool Settings
trello.desc: Increase the database connection pool size to 100 and separate worker and API pools in the configuration file to prevent coupling issues. Implement both changes in one pass.

trello.name: Update Payment Incident Runbook
trello.desc: Revise the payment incident runbook to include current logging links, document the queue drain procedure, and verify that all escalation phone numbers are up to date.

trello.name: Automate Status Page Updates
trello.desc: Automate the status page update process to trigger when the checkout error rate alert fires. Use the status provider's API to automatically set the page to 'investigating' with a template message.

trello.name: Plan Payment Processor Failover Test
trello.desc: Draft a game day plan for testing the payment processor failover. Conduct the test in staging and then in production during a low-traffic window. Ensure a rollback plan is in place and review the plan before execution.

trello.name: Upgrade Redis to Version 7.2
trello.desc: Schedule an upgrade from Redis 6.0 to 7.2, addressing the end-of-life version concerns. Prepare for a minor migration involving a config rename and changes to persistence defaults, requiring a proper change window.
